what: Vodafone is a telecom operator. After selling its Spanish and Italian businesses it is focused on Germany, the United Kingdom, other European markets, Turkey and Africa, where Vodacom and M-Pesa mobile money are important.
customers: Mobile and broadband customers across Europe and Africa, plus businesses buying connectivity and internet-of-things services.
money: the United Kingdom, Turkey, Portugal and others
enterprise connectivity and internet of things
moat: Spectrum and networks across many countries, plus M-Pesa, which is the payment system much of East Africa runs on.
risks: It reported a large loss in the latest period after impairments
German cable customers were lost after a change in apartment-block TV rules
opportunities: The merger with Three in the United Kingdom creates a stronger number-one mobile operator there
African mobile money grows far faster than European telecom
watch: German service revenue returning to growth and net debt reduction.
